English explanation: Conflict or opposition.

English explanation: To undermine something gradually or make it less stable.

English explanation: Policy concerning relations with other countries.

English explanation: Administration and circle around the royal house.

English explanation: Royal institution or family in a monarchy.

English explanation: Related to the king, queen, or royal house.

Norsk forklaring: Prins som er først i arverekken til tronen.
English explanation: Prince first in line to the throne.

Norsk forklaring: Prinsesse som er først i arverekken, eller gift med kronprinsen.
English explanation: Princess first in line, or married to the crown prince.

Norsk forklaring: Kalender over offentlige oppdrag og representasjon.
English explanation: Calendar of official duties and representation.

Norsk forklaring: Formell oppgave utført på vegne av en institusjon.
English explanation: Formal duty carried out on behalf of an institution.

Norsk forklaring: Mannlig medlem av kongefamilien.
English explanation: Male member of the royal family.

Forms: sg: (u) en prinsesse; (d) prinsessen; pl: (u) prinsesser; (d) prinsessene
Norsk forklaring: Kvinnelig medlem av kongefamilien.
English explanation: Female member of the royal family.

English explanation: As a representative for someone else.

English explanation: Act on behalf of a person, group, or institution.

English explanation: The Norwegian royal family’s official residence and administration.

English explanation: Travel somewhere, often to take part or follow something.

Forms: sg: (u) en tribune; (d) tribunen; pl: (u) tribuner; (d) tribunene
Norsk forklaring: Sted der publikum sitter eller står under arrangement.
English explanation: Place where the audience sits or stands during an event.

Forms: sg: (u) en trone; (d) tronen; pl: (u) troner; (d) tronene
Norsk forklaring: Symbolsk eller faktisk posisjon som monark.
English explanation: Symbolic or actual position as monarch.

Forms: sg: (u) en tronfølger; (d) tronfølgeren; pl: (u) tronfølgere; (d) tronfølgerne

English explanation: Member of the government responsible for a ministry.

Norsk forklaring: Statlig fagområde ledet av en minister.
English explanation: A government ministry led by a minister.

Norsk forklaring: Statlig etat som gjennomfører politikk og regler.
English explanation: Government agency that implements policy and rules.

Norsk forklaring: Regjeringens plan for statens inntekter og utgifter.
English explanation: The government budget for state income and expenditure.

Norsk forklaring: Avtale om hvordan budsjettet skal vedtas.
English explanation: Agreement on how a budget should be passed.

Norsk forklaring: Periode der berørte parter kan uttale seg om et forslag.
English explanation: Consultation round where affected parties can comment on a proposal.

Norsk forklaring: Siste dato for å sende inn høringssvar.
English explanation: Deadline for submitting consultation responses.

Norsk forklaring: Formell anbefaling fra en komité eller et utvalg.
English explanation: Formal recommendation from a committee or panel.

English explanation: Formal proposal from the government to parliament.

Norsk forklaring: Behandling av en sak i en politisk komité.
English explanation: Consideration of a matter in a parliamentary committee.

Norsk forklaring: Forslag til en ny lov eller en lovendring.
English explanation: Proposal for a new law or legal amendment.

English explanation: Change to an existing law.

Norsk forklaring: Offentlig skriv med retningslinjer eller presiseringer.
English explanation: Official circular with guidelines or clarifications.

English explanation: Statement expressing political confidence or support.

Norsk forklaring: Møte mellom ledere på høyt nivå.
English explanation: Meeting between high-level leaders.

English explanation: Person sent to represent a country or organization.

English explanation: Agreement to temporarily stop hostilities.

English explanation: Control of people or goods at a border.

English explanation: Package of economic or political sanctions.

Norsk forklaring: Løfte om sikkerhet eller beskyttelse.
English explanation: Promise of security or protection.

Forms: sg: (u) en allianse; (d) alliansen; pl: (u) allianseer; (d) allianseerene
Norsk forklaring: Formelt samarbeid mellom land eller partier.
English explanation: Formal cooperation between countries or parties.

English explanation: The opposing or other party in a conflict or negotiation.

Norsk forklaring: Person som følger en prosess uten å delta fullt ut.
English explanation: Person who observes a process without full participation.

Forms: sg: (u) en avtaletekst; (d) avtaleteksten; pl: (u) avtaletekster; (d) avtaleteksterene
Norsk forklaring: Den skriftlige teksten i en avtale.
English explanation: The written wording of an agreement.

Norsk forklaring: Partiets representanter på Stortinget.
English explanation: A party’s representatives in parliament.

Norsk forklaring: Leder for et politisk parti.
English explanation: Leader of a political party.

Norsk forklaring: Dokument som beskriver et partis politikk.
English explanation: Document describing a party’s policies.

English explanation: Agreement or plan showing the government’s policy.

English explanation: Government white paper/report to parliament on an issue.
